name: Toudou Rin
source:
[b]A Strict but Naive [i]Oni[/i] Sergeant-[i]Senpai[/i][/b]

Zodiac: Aries

A [i]senpai[/i] at Acacia Academy, she is [url=/c133874]Yui[/url]'s squad leader and instructor. An [i]oni[/i] who imposes strict training and life lessons. At first glance, she seems mannish and determined, but there are rumors that she is surprisingly a maiden at heart......!? In the dormitory, she shares a room with [url=/c133876]Yaeka[/url], and has a hard time dealing with the cheeky [i]kouhai[/i].

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://orthrossoft.jp/character/rin.html#rin]official website[/url]]
